SEE THE CHANGE. CHECK THE CAUSE.

A photo starts
the conversation.

One drone survey can contain hundreds of overlapping images. The useful job is to compare new observations with the last survey and group repeated signs of stress into areas a field team can inspect.

It supports scouting. A photograph alone cannot confirm disease, nutrient deficiency or a treatment.

How a survey becomes an inspection list
THE PROBLEM WORTH SOLVING

The survey is ready. The review takes longer.

A field survey can arrive as hundreds of overlapping images. An agronomist still has to find the relevant area, compare it with the last visit and give the scout a useful next action.

Read the operating problem
WHY NOW

Make the imagery useful at field level.

Drone and scouting images can be collected repeatedly through the growing cycle. The next useful step is a review process that groups the evidence and keeps the agronomist’s judgment close to it.

See the product workflow

THE AZURE ARCHITECTURE

Technology with
a defined job.

One drone survey can contain hundreds of overlapping images. The useful job is to compare new observations with the last survey and group repeated signs of stress into areas a field team can inspect.

Planning scenario: 691,200 image reviews per month. The capacity model is a planning basis, not current customer traffic.Follow the full processing path
  1. 01

    Azure Blob Storage

    Keep original drone images, field references and dated survey files together.

    Planned integration
  2. 02

    Azure Machine Learning

    Run batches of crop-image checks on a trained vision model; compare the same field across survey dates.

    Planned integration
  3. 03

    Azure OpenAI in Microsoft Foundry

    Turn grouped image observations and scout notes into a plain-language inspection brief.

    Connector implemented · configure Azure deployment
  4. 04

    Azure Service Bus

    Queue new surveys and retry failed work without reprocessing an unchanged survey.

    Planned integration
